verdict.rationale: Devin documents one built-in event-driven automation: when Devin Review with Auto-Fix is enabled, Devin automatically responds to code review comments and CI failures. That is a product-owned event-to-action behavior, but it is a preset toggle, not a general rules engine. Cron and one-time schedules are time-based and do not count as event triggers; Slack/Teams tagging is a manual invocation. missing for 10: user-definable event-trigger rules, configurable conditions and actions, a documented list of supported event sources, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Enable Devin Review with Auto-Fix so Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
